summary: Twilight Imperium: Fourth Edition is the definitive epic space 4X board game — a full evening (often 4-8+ hours) of galactic exploration, diplomacy, trade, and large-scale combat as each unique faction races toward a handful of victory points. Much of the drama comes not from the rules but from the table talk: alliances form and break, secret objectives are pursued, and huge fleet battles can swing the whole game.
praised: unmatched sense of epic scale and narrative emergence
satisfying combat and strategy-card action selection
criticised: enormous time commitment, often a full day for one game
steep rules complexity and long first-play teaching time
can be brutal for a player who falls behind or gets ganged up on
table size and space requirements are a real barrier

interaction.kind: open conflict, diplomacy and area control on a shared galaxy
interaction.detail: All players expand, build, and fight across one shared modular galaxy map, so claiming systems and jump lanes directly denies them to rivals. Fleets engage in dice-based combat that destroys opponents' units, while formal trading and a voting phase mean deals and political maneuvering are core to play, not incidental.

subsystems: Special point sources (Mecatol/relics/Support for the Throne)
scoring.how_you_win: You expand, build, and fight to complete public and secret objectives each round, scoring victory points as you go; the first player to reach 10 points wins immediately.
scoring.score_note: game ends the instant a player hits the target (10 VP standard, 14 in longer variant)

similar: Eclipse: Second Dawn for the Galaxy
Rex: Final Days of an Empire
